'''Maujasi''' was a name given to the [[Human/Legends|Human]] members of the [[Mauja]] clans of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Haurgab]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] Maujasi allied themselves with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and fought against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Battle of Haurgab]].
